_note: MUSIC DECK (Layer 2 for sound, 2026-08-13) — mirrors styles/deck.json. A LANE is a curated instrumentation recipe + a rhythm feel; the composer assigns one per journey (journey field `music_lane`), matched to the journey's mood the way a visual style is. The BRAND TAIL below is fixed and appended to every candidate — it carries the Powers-of-Zen sound (chill/hypnotic/spacious) and the deep-downbeat doctrine (a soft deep kick ON the morph downbeat; never snare/hi-hat/cymbals/woodblock — Phil 2026-08-12). Add lanes as the pool mines out; keep instrumentation words TIMBRAL (never genre/era words that drag in drum kits).
brand_tail: chill hypnotic ambient, spacious moody reverb, oddly satisfying, cinematic, instrumental, no vocals

rhythms.downbeat: all percussion is a single deep soft kick drum landing exactly on the downbeat of every bar, felt in the chest, steady and ever-present
rhythms.heartbeat: all percussion is a deep sub-bass heartbeat, two soft low beats then space, the first landing exactly on the downbeat of every bar
rhythms.third_answer: all percussion is a deep soft kick on the downbeat of every bar and a quieter deep thump answering on beat three, everything low and round
rhythms.halftime: all percussion is a single deep 808 kick landing exactly on the downbeat, long empty space between hits, spacious and heavy

glass_chapel.instr: crystalline glass bells and a soft distant choir pad, airy shimmer

wooden_orbit.instr: warm marimba and kalimba over a round woody bass, gentle plucked figures

deep_archive.instr: dark oceanic pads and a deep warm sub bass drone, slow blooming swells

night_market.instr: soft hang drum and plucked koto over a velvet pad, intimate and close

analog_dawn.instr: warm analog synth pads with gentle tape warble and a soft round mallet

choir_of_dust.instr: a soft choir-like pad, glass harmonica and fine granular shimmer

music_box.instr: a tiny music box and celesta over a low warm drone, delicate struck tines

tide_organ.instr: a breathy reed organ and soft water textures over a deep sub pulse

aurora_strings.instr: bowed string pad swells and sparse harp plucks, silvery and cold

ember_pulse.instr: a deep 808 heartbeat under smoky low pads and distant soft chimes

_negatives_note: 2026-08-13: 'no snare/no hi-hat' phrasing REMOVED from tags — naming an instrument to a tag-conditioned model summons it, and ACE's negative conditioning is zeroed at cfg 1 so prose bans did nothing. Percussion is now specified by POSITIVE EXCLUSIVITY ('all percussion is ...') and the deep-pulse ranking metric culls violators.
